title: Answer the business questions (stage 1, about 20 minutes)
detail: Promise, money, your name on the site, test phone numbers, what the agents may do alone, monthly spend cap. Claude asks them as multiple choice.

title: Create the GitHub repo and install the Claude GitHub App on it
detail: Private repo. Claude does all GitHub work after this.

items: github.com → New repository → name it → Private → Create
github.com/apps/claude → Configure → add the new repo

title: Install the starter kit, CLAUDE.md and the playbook
detail: Runs starter-kit/install.sh from a MoveMatch checkout. MoveMatch is not changed.

title: Accounts exist and are paid for 💳
detail: Vercel, Supabase (paid plan), Twilio (upgraded), Meta Business portfolio, Google Analytics + Ads (billing), ChatGPT, Microsoft Clarity, Anthropic Console, email on the domain. Agents never enter card details.

title: Log in once to every console in Chrome (Claude in Chrome on)
detail: Meta Business / WhatsApp Manager, Google Ads, GA4, Search Console, Twilio, Vercel, Supabase, Anthropic, Clarity, ChatGPT, Gmail. Finish 2FA so sessions last.

items: Install Claude in Chrome; in Claude Code run /chrome → Enabled by default
Open each console in that Chrome profile, sign in, tick "stay signed in"
Tell Claude "preflight"; it opens each one and fills in the check table

title: Put the business documents in one folder
detail: Incorporation certificate or עוסק מורשה, exact registered name, number and address, logo. The agents fill forms from it; you press the final Submit.

title: Connect GitHub, Supabase, Vercel, Gmail and Drive on claude.ai
detail: API keys (e.g. Twilio) go into the secure form the agent shows you, never into the chat.

title: Allow Claude app notifications on your phone
detail: You get a push notification whenever something needs paying or your OK.

title: Stage briefs drafted and approved: bizdev, product, design, marketing
detail: Each stage ends with a short summary and "Approve and move on?".

title: Buy the domain and click the registrar's verification email 💳
detail: Vercel → Domains → Buy. The contact-verification email must be clicked within 15 days.

title: Test area /qa, test-lead guard, kill switch and throttle live
detail: Built before any sending code. Test leads (QA names, ?utm_source=qa) send no WhatsApp and nothing to providers.

title: Upgrade the database to the paid plan 💳
detail: Media fills the free plan after a few videos.

title: Twilio Trust Hub profile approved and WhatsApp sender connected
detail: The agent fills everything; you press Submit. The email must use the website's domain and the address must match the registry exactly.

title: WhatsApp Utility templates submitted and approved; IDs in Vercel
detail: Link written in the template body, never a whole URL in a variable. Meta usually answers within a day.

title: Inbound and status webhooks set and tested with one message from your phone
detail: On MoveMatch every inbound message was refused for a week unnoticed.

title: Warm up the WhatsApp number
detail: You, a family member and each new provider send a first message before real volume.

title: Real providers active, each with a real WhatsApp number and service areas
detail: Demo or test providers stay inactive. Claude reconciles this list with the database before launch.

title: Coverage table: areas with at least 2 active providers
detail: Ads target only these areas.

title: Legal pages, consent lines, provider agreement and commission clause live
detail: Best-effort draft; a lawyer still signs off.

title: Legal mailbox on the domain receives mail
detail: Send one test email and confirm it arrives.

title: GA4 events and Ads conversions verified (qualify_lead Primary, lead_complete Secondary, Count: One)
detail: No button click is a conversion. A WhatsApp chat funnel shows 0 conversions in Ads; measure it in admin and GA4.

title: Microsoft Clarity live on funnel pages only, production domain only, /qa tagged env=qa
detail: Tracking must never break a funnel: guard every call.

title: ChatGPT brief written; ChatGPT builds the campaigns Paused; Claude checks them
detail: The agent pastes the brief into ChatGPT in your Chrome and checks Google Ads against it.

title: Choose the funnels the ads send people to
detail: Few funnels, each with a written hypothesis, so clicks aren't split too thin.

title: Decide whether the homepage is live at launch
detail: Until then its leads reach only you.

title: Admin ready: leads, filters, providers by area, money tab, funnel results, inbox, manual send and add-video
detail: Customers send missing details on WhatsApp; the operator needs these tools on day 1.

title: Message map with the real texts of every automated message
detail: Second artifact, linked from Quick links.

title: Delete demo and test data before paid traffic (count first, your OK)
detail: On MoveMatch the owner said 6 and there were 16.

title: QA go / no-go
detail: Every funnel at phone width on /qa, Twilio log clean, no page errors, nothing sent from tests.

title: Enable the campaigns 🔴
detail: Only you press Enable or raise a budget.

title: Launch-day check after the first 3–5 real leads
detail: Twilio error codes (63005, 63016, 63024, 63049, 63051), server logs, the right providers alerted, GA4 events, lead data complete.

title: Check the WhatsApp quality rating weekly and the day after any spike
detail: WhatsApp Manager → Account quality. Yellow or red means slow down.

title: Lawyer sign-off on terms, privacy and accessibility
detail: Most important: commission terms and the privacy law.

title: Tell Claude "switch autonomy to live"
detail: After launch, every production deploy needs your OK.

title: Confirm the first automatic deletion of old media
detail: Nightly job; verify once a deletion date is reached.

title: Review parked decisions
detail: Things decided "not now" stay here so they aren't forgotten.
